messages:
Lena: spotted a silent increase in text-fallback routing for fncalls on eu-west at 03:20. validation rejects spiking but console shows no route-level breakdown.
Tom: do we know if these rejects are true schema mismatches or adapter truncation?
Lena: logs indicate a mix. some SCHEMA_ERROR, some STREAM_CLOSED_midframe. validator lumps both into structured_reject.
Ibrahim: short-term: we can add a tag reject_reason to the router logs and emit metric validation.rejects{route,reason}. that'll let console filter by route.
Tom: agree. also add a small instrumentation: on fallback path include original route_id in headers so billing/traceback preserves origin.
Lena: product wants a rollout toggle in console: "prefer-retry-for-partial". should be off by default.
Ibrahim: implement router policy: if error_code==STREAM_CLOSED and retry_budget>0 and route.slo != latency_critical then enqueue retry.
console-bot: note recorded: create dashboard tile for validation.rejects by route+reason and a rollout toggle for prefer-retry-for-partial.
Tom: i'll own the router change + header passthrough. Ibrahim: telemetry and dashboard?
Ibrahim: on it. will sample 5% of rejects with payloads (PII redaction) for offline replay.
Lena: thanks. follow-up: patch adapters to emit STREAM_CLOSED codes and then flip the console toggle in staging for 25% canary.
thread_summary: Team noticed increased fncall fallbacks. Decided to emit reject_reason tags, preserve origin route on fallback, add a console toggle to retry on partial streams, and sample rejects for replay.
